rows.en: (Phew~, classes are finally over for today~)

\p-kun,
do you have a minute?
rows.notes: Also listed under the female version of the scene.

rows.en: Oh, Nanase. What's up?

Um, I'd like to ask you to do a little
heavy lifting for me...
Huh? What's going on?

Yes, there's something I'd like you
to carry to the art room for me...
Oh, no problem at all. So what is it?

Thank you so much!
Um, it's this right here...
Huh?! This huge plaster statue?!

Yes, I'm sorry.
Could I ask you to do it?
rows.notes: Shared m/f; in the female scene the two carry it together, 'ask you to do it' fits both.

rows.en: Oh... s-sure...

(Phew~, I'm beat...
It might've been easier if I'd carried it
wearing my EX-Gear...)
(Phew~, classes are finally over for today~)

\p-san,
do you have a minute?
Um, I'd like to ask you for a little help...
Huh? What? What's up?

Yes, there's something I'd like you
to help me carry to the art room...
Sure, got it. So what is it?
Um... this huge plaster statue?!
Oh... r-right...

(Phew~, I'm beat...
With my EX-Gear on, I could've carried it
easily, even by myself.)

(Whoa, it's Ranka everywhere.
She's really started climbing the stairs
to stardom as the Super Dimension Cinderella.)
rows.notes: Shared with nml_rnk_018 and nml_she_018 (male); works in all three.

rows.en:
What are you doing in a place like this,
\p-kun?

Oh, Nanase.
I was just amazed at how well Ranka's doing.

...I'm happy Ranka-san made it as an idol,
but it also feels like she's gone somewhere
far away, and that makes me a little sad...
Nanase...

You care about Ranka that much, right?
So of course Ranka thinks of you
as a precious friend too.

So you don't need to think that
Ranka's gone off somewhere far away.

\p-kun...
Thank you.

You're right.
From now on, I have to keep cheering
Ranka-san on with all I've got!
That's the spirit, Nanase.
(Nanase really loves Ranka, huh.)

(Whoa, it's Ranka-chan everywhere.
She's really started climbing the stairs
to stardom as the Super Dimension Cinderella.)

What are you doing in a place like this,
\p-san?

Oh, Nanase.
I was just amazed at how well Ranka-chan's doing.

You care about Ranka-chan that much, right?
So of course Ranka-chan thinks of you
as a precious friend too.

So you don't need to think that
Ranka-chan's gone off somewhere far away.

\p-san...
Thank you.
That's the spirit, Nanase.
(Nanase really loves Ranka-chan, huh.)

(Hmm... I've been wondering about this
for a while now...)

Hey, Nanase, don't they get in the way,
being that big?
rows.notes: Deliberately ambiguous: the player means her glasses (c18852), Nanase hears her chest. 'they' keeps both readings.

rows.en: I've heard they give you stiff shoulders, right?

Stiff shoulders, getting in the way in P.E.,
boys staring at them...
There's nothing good about them at all!

How could you make fun of someone's
complex like that...
You're the worst!!!
Huh?! Ah, Nanase...

(Huh?
Umm, I was asking about her glasses...)
I've heard they give you stiff shoulders, right?
(Nanase really loves Ranka, doesn't she...)
You and Ranka sure are close, huh, Nanase.

Of course!
Ranka-san and I are each other's one and
only best friend!

From the moment we met, Ranka-san was
just so lovely...
Ranka-san...
H-Heyyy, Nanase?

Oh, n-no!
I almost got lost in my own little world.

Do you understand?!
\p-kun!
U-Understand what?

Ranka-san is an angel who descended
upon this Frontier!!
U-Uh, okay...
Please show Ranka-san more reverence!!
(Nanase loves Ranka way too much...)
(Nanase really loves Ranka-chan, doesn't she.)
You and Ranka-chan sure are close, huh, Nanase.

Do you understand?!
\p-san!
(Nanase loves Ranka-chan way too much...)

uncertain: c18846: 'don't they get in the way, being that big?' keeps the glasses/chest misunderstanding with 'they'.
